INPUT_DIR = "./input"

TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading training data...")
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
df_sample = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

print(f"Training data shape: {df_train.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {df_test.shape}")

# Extract features and target - CRITICAL FIX: identify columns BEFORE any indexing
id_col = "Id"
target_col = "Cover_Type"

# Get feature columns EXCLUDING id and target
train_columns = df_train.columns.tolist()
feature_cols = [col for col in train_columns if col != id_col and col != target_col]

X_train_full = df_train[feature_cols].copy()
y_train_full = df_train[target_col].values

X_test_features = df_test[feature_cols].copy()

print(f"Number of features: {len(feature_cols)}")
print(f"Class distribution of target:\n{pd.Series(y_train_full).value_counts()}")

# Split for hold-out validation - remove stratification due to class imbalance
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full,
    y_train_full,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,

)

    seed=42,
    eval_metric='mlogloss',
    use_label_encoder=False,
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validation scoring - MUST NOT refit on full data after training

print(f"\nHold-out validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Predictions on test set - use ORIGINAL test data WITHOUT refitting
